method: Fresh processes; ten prepared 32768-iteration guest kernel warmups before one timed million-iteration kernel. The kernel mutates payload bytes and repeatedly accesses the actual physical metadata. Preparation and printing are outside clocks. Every checksum is independently derived in Python. These are hot metadata controls, not example entry or process timings.
